newsitem.title: CHINA: Armstrong in $42 mln China venture.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong in $42 mln China venture.

text.p: U.S.-based Armstrong World Industries Inc has set up a $42 million joint venture with a Chinese firm to make fire-resistant ceiling materials, the China Daily said on Wednesday.
The new venture, Armstrong Building Product (Shanghai) Co Ltd, was launched on Tuesday with the Shanghai Advanced Building Materials Co, the newspaper said.
Armstrong Shanghai would produce soundproofing and fire resistant materials for use in ceilings, the newspaper said.
It did not say what annual production or projected sales of the new venture would be.
Armstrong would continue to import some types of ceilings that could not be manufactured by the joint venture, it quoted an Armstrong official as saying.
Armstrong has a wholly-owned factory in Panyu in the southern province of Guangdong to make thermal insulation for pipelines, and has sales offices in Shanghai, Beijing and Guangzhou.
